2026_05_CHI_GB.headline: Bagent prepares for Love and the Packers at Lambeau Field
2026_05_CHI_GB.paragraph1: Chicago plans to start Tyson Bagent while Caleb Williams recovers from a hamstring injury. Bagent led long possessions against the Jets, but Green Bay will challenge him to find explosive completions without forcing throws. Jordan Love has produced efficiently against the Bears in past meetings, and the Packers can test Chicago’s run defense before using play action. Green Bay is managing injuries along its interior offensive line and defensive front, making protection calls and early-down gains especially important. The Bears need reliable tackling and another composed performance from Bagent.
2026_05_CHI_GB.model_rationale: Chicago needs efficient possessions to support its defense, while Green Bay can lean on Love’s experience and a balanced attack. Protection and early-down discipline will shape the matchup.
